title: Sending BG Readings from Verio Flex to xDrip to MongoDB
body:
Hello,

I have xDrip set up and connected to my Onetouch Verio Flex, but not to a CGM.  The readings from the Verio Flex are properly being captured and displayed in xDrip, but are not being send to MongoDB.  The MongoDB connection is working, but only the "devicestatus" collection with phone battery status is present and being populated, not the "entries" collection.

Do I have an improper configuration, or do readings from the Verio Flex simply not get sent to MongoDB as a matter of designed functionality?

Thanks,

Jason
